_doc: EXAMPLE ONLY -- documents the shared vehicle calibration schema: steering servo (center position + travel limits + invert) AND drive-direction sign (drive_invert) -- see VescDriver/src/SteeringCalib.h. This file is never written to by any program: vesc_teleop/vesc_driver/future MPC-side tools read/write the LIVE calibration at $HOME/.vesc/steering_calib.json (or wherever --steering-calib points), never here -- this repo-shipped copy is only a read-only fallback/reference (see SteeringCalib.h's resolve_load_path(), tier 3) and a schema example for documentation.
_center_doc: servo position (0..1) that points the wheels straight ahead.
_min_pos_doc: servo position (0..1) at full lock in one direction -- must satisfy 0<=min_pos<center.
_max_pos_doc: servo position (0..1) at full lock in the other direction -- must satisfy center<max_pos<=1.
_invert_doc: EXAMPLE -- flips the sign of steering-to-servo mapping if the servo turns the wrong way.
_rad_per_unit_doc: PLACEHOLDER -- radians of steering angle per unit of servo position; 0 means unknown/uncalibrated. Reserved for later steering-angle work, not consumed by anything yet.
_drive_invert_doc: EXAMPLE -- whole-vehicle property, true if the robot's 'forward' motor command sign is physically inverted by wiring, so DRIVE code must negate the sign of its motor command when this is true.
note: example fixture -- not a real calibration
_saved_unix_time_doc: EXAMPLE -- a real saved file records time(nullptr) at save time here.
